purpose: Exact allowlist of raw attempt logs/inputs/provenance to copy; exclude executables and build objects. Does not replace canonical final-clean-SHA campaign.
path_contract: Every file source is absolute and archive_path is relative to the delivery ZIP root. Copy only files listed in attempts[].files. Directory names in source_selections are discovery roots, NOT instructions to copy entire trees.
retention_limit: All currently retained raw attempt logs are listed. Routine build log paths were reused across incremental rebuilds; previous contents of those same paths are not claimed to exist. First mathematical/publication failures and initial Debug-probe abort are preserved as separate logs.
